mechanism: As expiration approaches, the same Henry Hub futures contract is more sensitive to new information and its return variability rises relative to more distant contracts.

target.price_semantics: UTC electronic-trade bar close; never settlement
target.return: same-contract consecutive-observation log close return computed before expiry ranking
target.curve: outright Henry Hub monthly contracts ranked by delivery/expiry order; retain M1 through M12

mepi.rationale: A 20% nearby-over-distant volatility premium is a deliberately material stylized-fact threshold; the successor is a data/market-semantics confirmation, not a trading-PnL claim.

benchmark: No material Samuelson effect: M1/M12 volatility ratio <= 1.20

dependence.method: moving-block bootstrap over ordered eligible trade dates
dependence.decision_rule: advance only if the one-sided 95% lower confidence bound for log(M1/M12 volatility ratio) exceeds log(1.20)

multiplicity.procedure: none; exactly one confirmatory primary claim

untouched_confirmation_allocation.eligibility: first 252 distinct eligible NG.FUT ohlcv-1d trade dates strictly after 2026-08-12 with both M1 and M12 same-contract returns available
untouched_confirmation_allocation.source_identity: future Databento acquisition must be independently manifested and SHA-256 verified before opening outcomes

parameters_frozen.return_frequency: one ohlcv-1d observation to next observation for the same contract

outcome_use: The 2010-06-06 through 2026-08-12 archive is consumed exploratory development evidence and is forbidden as confirmation for this specification.
